mapper.select: SELECT id, public_id, vehicle_id, created_at FROM trip WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip (public_id, vehicle_id, status, car_consented_at, created_at, last_activity_at) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{vehicleId}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip SET status = #{status}, ended_at = #{now}, dest_name = NULL, dest_lat = NULL, dest_lng = NULL, last_lat = NULL, last_lng = NULL, last_heading = NULL, last_reported_at = NULL, energy_type = NULL, energy_pct = NULL, range_m = NULL WHERE id = #{tripId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND last_activity_at < #{idleBefore}
UPDATE trip SET last_activity_at = #{now} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO trip_passenger (trip_id, passenger_id, joined_at, consented_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{passengerId}, #{now}, #{now})
